note: Every System Control view, and the punarctl verb a terminal uses for the same answer (terminal parity: docs/api/ipc.md section 7). A view with no verb names why in `exception`; a view whose verb covers only part of it names the rest in `gap`. tests/desktop/terminal-parity-gate-test.sh checks that every view id in SystemControl/ControlData.qml is here and nothing stale is; punarctl's unit tests check that every verb parses.

network.gap: The interface, gateway, link state and MAC rows are read from /proc/net/route and /sys/class/net; `punarctl network links` (parity plan section 2, gap 2) is not built yet.

bluetooth.exception: No Bluetooth stack ships, and the view is a statement of that absence; there is nothing for a verb to report.

models.exception: No local model registry exists; the view is a statement of that absence.

mcp.exception: MCP servers are not observed yet; the view is a statement of that absence.

containers.exception: Environments belong to punar-env, which has its own command line (`punar-env up`); the view points there rather than reading a container runtime nothing mediates.

toolchains.exception: No toolchain registry exists; the view is a statement of that absence.
